relations.subject: Sakya Trizin Ngawang Kunga
relations.evidence: From his father, Vajradhara Ngawang Kunga Rinchen, he received important initiations and teachings in the Sakya lineage.

relations.subject: Sakya Trizin Ngawang Kunga
relations.evidence: He continued intensive training from his main teacher Ngawang Lodroe Shenpen Nyingpo and many other famous Tibetan scholars

relations.subject: Ratna Vajra Rinpoche
relations.evidence: After passing the throne of the Sakya lineage to his elder son Ratna Vajra Rinpoche who became the 42nd Sakya Trizin on 9 March 2017

relations.subject: Ratna Vajra Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He has trained both of his sons as Buddhists, and they both travel widely, teaching Buddhism throughout the world.

relations.subject: Gyana Vajra Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He has trained both of his sons as Buddhists, and they both travel widely, teaching Buddhism throughout the world.

relations.subject: Sakya Trizin Ngawang Kunga
relations.evidence: in 1964, Ngawang Kunga re-established the seat of the Sakya in Rajpur, India, building a monastery known as Sakya Centre.

relations.subject: Sakya Trizin Ngawang Kunga
relations.evidence: He founded and directly guides a number of institutions, including Sakya Monastery in Rajpur, Sakya Institute, Sakya College, Sakya Nunnery, Sakya College for Nuns
